photos.caption: NASA's video, clock 12:46:50
photos.how: Frame from NASA's video at 1775 s; on-screen clock 05/18/13 12:46:50, wanted 12:46:50 (within 20 s; the matrix time plus one day). NASA's as-run matrix gives this test's start as 'GMT 137  msg 12:46-12:52' on 2013-05-17 (`as run matrix!B122`), read as 2013-05-17 12:46. The video's on-screen clock reads one day later than the matrix on every day both cover, the same kind of offset NASA states for this clock on BASS-II, so the clock was searched for 2013-05-17 plus one day, 12:46: it was found 1725 s into this video, and in no other video.
